# Redis: config

Runtime: GLM / AgentPress material kit.

Redis configuration endpoints allow agents to programmatically adjust cache, queue, and vector settings. SOURCE FACT REQUIRED: exact config parameter names, SOURCE FACT REQUIRED: exact parameter values and defaults, SOURCE FACT REQUIRED: exact API request/response shapes for config changes. Without compact context, agents misconfigure and cause silent failures.

Search intents:
- Redis config parameters
- Redis API config changes
- Redis configuration settings

Validation command: python3 scripts/agentpress.py material-kit-validate agentpress/material-kits/redis-config --json
